message.content: 1) Yes, product cards are small/compact (5 columns on desktop, smaller images, tight padding). 2) Yes, a 'Sorter:' dropdown is visible near the top showing 'Anbefalt'. 3) Yes, each product card shows: small badge (e.g., Nyhet/Bestselger/Tilbud), tiny category label, product name, subtitle, stock status, price, and a small rating row (star + rating + review count).
